arguments.command:
cd /workspace/scratch && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
src = open('tune2.py').read()
src = src.replace("A.SOLVER_PARAMS = mode",
"""if mode == 'none':
    A.SOLVER_PARAMS = ()
else:
    name, val = mode.split('=')
    A.SOLVER_PARAMS = ((name, int(val) if val.lstrip('-').isdigit() else (val=='true' if val in ('true','false') else val)),)""")
open('tune2.py','w').write(src)
PYEOF
rm -f tune2.log; for md in "none" "arith.branch_cut_ratio=4" "arith.branch_cut_ratio=8" "pb.learn_complements=false" "random_seed=7" "phase_selection=5"; do timeout 100 python3 -u tune2.py 3 3 "$md" >> tune2.log 2>&1 || echo "FAIL $md" >> tune2.log; done; cat tune2.log
